items.name: Sarah Jenkins
items.bio: I build and ship web products end to end — front-end, APIs and the deployment pipeline. Ten years of experience across startups and agencies, and I like projects where I own the outcome rather than a ticket.

reviews.name: Rachel Adams
reviews.text: The most organised developer we have worked with. Daily updates, no surprises, and the launch was completely uneventful — in the best way.

reviews.name: Kevin Doyle
reviews.text: Architected a rewrite that cut our hosting bill by 40%. Reads code like a reviewer and writes it like an owner.

reviews.name: Marta Kowal
reviews.text: Estimates honestly, delivers on the estimate, and flags risks early. Exactly what you want in a senior contractor.

items.name: Michael Chen
items.bio: I help early-stage companies look like they have been around for years. Positioning, identity and the design system that keeps it consistent once the team starts growing.

reviews.name: Felix Grant
reviews.text: Ask the hard positioning questions before opening Figma. That discipline is why our rebrand actually stuck.

reviews.name: Aisha Rahman
reviews.text: A rare mix of strategic thinking and craft. Our deck, site and packaging finally speak the same language.

reviews.name: Tom Fletcher
reviews.text: Superb work at a premium rate. Worth it for a funding round or a rebrand, less so for small one-off jobs.

items.name: Elena Rodriguez
items.bio: I write content that ranks and reads like a human wrote it. Editorial background, agency speed, and a spreadsheet habit when it comes to keyword research.

reviews.name: Georgia Mills
reviews.text: Briefs come back better than they went in. Fourteen months of articles and I have never had to rewrite one.

reviews.name: Daniel Okafor
reviews.text: Organic sessions doubled in a quarter. She cares about the business, not just the word count.

reviews.name: Helen Zhao
reviews.text: Excellent long-form work. Occasionally slower to respond during her busy weeks, but always delivers.

items.name: David Kim
items.bio: Former analytics lead at a marketplace, now helping teams stop arguing about numbers. Dashboards, forecasting and the unglamorous data cleanup that makes both possible.

reviews.name: Victor Huang
reviews.text: Turned three conflicting reports into one number everyone trusts. Calm, precise and fast.

reviews.name: Sara Lindqvist
reviews.text: Set up our dbt models and documented them properly for once. The handover was flawless.

reviews.name: Omar Farouk
reviews.text: Found the retention leak that had been hiding in our funnel for a year. Paid for the engagement many times over.

items.name: James Carter
items.bio: Editor and motion designer for brands that need content weekly. Documentary pacing for long-form, fast hooks for vertical, and a library of transitions that never gets gimmicky.

reviews.name: Mia Kowalski
reviews.text: Delivers a week of content from one shoot. Our posting schedule has never slipped since we started working together.

reviews.name: Chris Bannon
reviews.text: Great instinct for what to cut. Forty-minute episodes now feel like twenty, without losing the good parts.

reviews.name: Nina Costa
reviews.text: Strong creative and clean files. Book him early — his calendar fills up fast.

items.name: Anna Klein
items.bio: Performance marketer who treats ad spend like it is coming out of my own pocket. Full-funnel paid social and search, with creative testing built into every account I run.

reviews.name: Owen Fletcher
reviews.text: Took over an account that was losing money and had it profitable in six weeks. Ruthless about killing bad campaigns.

reviews.name: Julia Rossi
reviews.text: Strong results and clear reporting. Direct communication style is not for everyone, but it works.

reviews.name: Mark Sullivan
reviews.text: The first marketer who sent us a dashboard instead of a pitch deck. Renewed twice already.

items.name: Marcus Lee
items.bio: Cross-platform mobile developer shipping apps to the App Store and Play Store since 2016. Comfortable owning the whole release cycle, including the store submissions nobody enjoys.

reviews.name: Priyanka Nair
reviews.text: Guided our first store submission through review without a single rejection. Steady, experienced and easy to brief.

reviews.name: Eric Lund
reviews.text: Rewrote our flaky build pipeline and the crash rate dropped by 80%. Thorough documentation left behind.

reviews.name: Siti Rahman
reviews.text: Reliable and communicative. Slightly more expensive than alternatives, but the quality justifies it.
